name: Carrot Oat Halwa
steps: Heat the oil and sauté the grated carrot for 5 minutes until soft and fragrant.
Add the soy milk and oats and cook on medium-low for 12–15 minutes, stirring often, until thick.
Stir in the cardamom and saffron or cinnamon.
note: A traditional gajar halwa has sugar, ghee and condensed milk; here the carrots and soy milk provide the sweetness and body.
